id: title:VojtechBartos:stop re rendering old messages when a run resumes

observations.behavior: Adds a boolean flag `atFoot: true` to the `pushHuman` call and stores the returned ID and text in a `waitingSends` array.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the stream renderer to distinguish between a message rendered at the foot of the stream and other messages, and retain metadata for pending sends.

observations.behavior: Clears the `pairedSends` set after processing an error, removing the clearing of paired sends from the conditional block.
observations.posthog_connection: Resets the pairing state after an error, potentially clearing cached associations between paired messages.

observations.behavior: Removes items of type 'progress' from the stream and pops the last item from `waitingSends` before processing an error, retaining the undelivered message in the stream.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the stream rendering behavior when an error occurs, retaining the undelivered message rather than removing it, and clearing the waiting send queue.
